propositions: A project overlay entry keyed by a built-in overlay id must support additive trigger_tokens (literal substring matching on unified diff lines) and applies_to globs that union with committed globs, without replacing committed semantics via effective_routing.

The glob_triggered_overlays and content_triggered_overlays functions must consume project trigger extensions via a project_trigger_extensions helper that reads the project routing's code_review section directly, bypassing effective_routing's overlay-wins merge.

Project trigger extensions on built-in overlay ids must fire (return that id) when diff content matches any token or file globs match any applies_to pattern, with added and removed lines both eligible for token matching.
Malformed project overlay entries (non-list trigger_tokens, non-string tokens, unknown overlay ids) must be silently ignored without raising exceptions.
With no project overlay present, glob_triggered_overlays and content_triggered_overlays must produce identical results to current behavior, verified by unchanged pre-existing test corpus.
